item.title: Bucks coach Doc Rivers says he anticipates Giannis Antetokounmpo missing about 4 weeks
item.description: MILWAUKEE (AP) — Milwaukee Bucks coach Doc Rivers says he anticipates Giannis Antetokounmpo missing about a month as the two-time MVP recovers from a strained right calf . Initial reports indicated Antetokounmpo would be out two to four weeks.

item.title: Canada to face United States in final of Para Cup hockey tournament
item.description: DAWSON CREEK — Canada will face an old rival for gold at the Para Cup. Dominic Cozzolino scored twice and added three assists as the hosts topped Czechia 7-0 on Friday to make the hockey tournament's title match.

item.title: Rantanen has goal and 2 assists as Stars beat Sharks 4-1 to extend point streak to nine games
item.description: DALLAS (AP) — Mikko Rantanen had a goal and two assists, and the Dallas Stars scored three times in the third period to beat the San Jose Sharks 4-1 on Friday night.

item.title: Gilgeous-Alexander's 33 points in 3 quarters power Thunder to 14th straight win
item.description: OKLAHOMA CITY (AP) — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 33 in three quarters, and the Oklahoma City Thunder defeated the Dallas Mavericks 132-111 on Friday night to claim their 14th straight win.

item.title: Mexican composer turns fire and ritual into a musical journey of renewal
item.description: MEXICO CITY (AP) — Mexican composer María Leonora prepares for each concert as if she’s gearing up for battle. Her makeup has a tribal edge. Her clothes are arranged in layers she sheds as the show unfolds.

item.title: Ducks snap Capitals' 6-game winning streak with 4-3 shootout victory on goals by Terry, McTavish
item.description: ANAHEIM, Calif. (AP) — Troy Terry and Mason McTavish scored in the shootout, and the Anaheim Ducks snapped the Washington Capitals' six-game winning streak with a 4-3 victory Friday night.

item.title: Argentina and Messi will open their World Cup defense against Algeria. The US starts vs. Paraguay
